## Review Pulse – 3b Analyse (v2)
**Loop:** Read reviews → tag next 400 untagged (base sample first) → write back → loop again, until nothing is left (guard: 10 loops). Every chunk is saved before the next, so an interrupted run resumes where it stopped.

**Then:** computes the 10-week stats + fee issue (code, not AI) and saves to `runs`. Status is `analysed` only when ≥95% of reviews in the window are tagged.

One click does the one-time backfill (~10 min). Weekly runs take ~2 min.
